author: j. s. fields
title: Danielle McGonigle named Conference USA Indoor Field Performer of the Meet
text:
FIU women’s indoor track athlete Danielle McGonigle was named Conference USA Indoor Field Performer of the Meet, according to a March 10 announcement from the league.
The recognition highlights McGonigle’s achievements during the recent conference meet. Her performance is notable as she secured one of two gold medals for FIU in the triple jump, successfully defending her 2025 title with a personal-best mark of 12.67 meters.
In addition to her gold medal in the triple jump, McGonigle set personal records in several other events over the weekend. She achieved new bests in the 800 meters (2:37.12), long jump (5.88 meters), and pentathlon (3501 points).
McGonigle and her teammates are now preparing for their next challenge at the NCAA Indoor Championships, which begin on Friday.
Her recent accomplishments underscore her continued development as an athlete and position her as a key competitor for FIU at upcoming national events.
